environment: macOS ARM64, Chromium, standalone container adapter and native Hub connector with a synthetic Hub owner proxy and AWS fixture, Colima ARM64
observations: Restoring the old bridge reproduced a timeout waiting for Connect AWS. Restoring the candidate allowed a browser owner to open the AWS form, approve the Identity Center fixture, confirm the selected role, and retry a protected resource read. The fixture denied anonymous, cross-account, direct browser and other-provider enrollment. Credentials were absent from Chat, and the CLI denied use before confirmation. The real Docker image included AWS CLI and passed standalone acceptance. The skill evaluation passed. The AWS service and Hub browser's owner grant in this scenario were synthetic.
